title: Axiom Beta Implies Elementary Transfinite Recursion
summary: We show that $\mathbf{C}$, a weak theory of sets with Axiom Beta, proves the scheme of Elementary, or $Δ_0$ Transfinite Recursion and can generate, for every set, the corresponding relativized constructible hierarchy. We show that the theory $\mathbf{C}$ corresponds to Simpson's system $\mathbf{ATR}_0^\text{set}$ without the Axiom of Countability. In fact, $\mathbf{C}$ proves the totality of the Veblen function and of all primitive recursive set functions.
